content.comment_body: Hello, I've developed my program for a [article_no] device, installed [product_name] V8.0, read that I need to upgrade, then updated to V8.1 and V8.2. However, I still can't connect to the [product_name] from my PC for downloading the program. My firmware version is: [version_no]. I am able to ping the [product_name] and go online, but unable to download my software. Any suggestions? I've searched Google and [company_name] support but haven't found a solution. Thank you.

You mentioned you can go online without issue, so the connection itself should be fine. It's possible there's an error in your program. When you try to upload your program to the [product_name], check the lower right of the [product_name] software. If you see a small animated 'i', there's likely an error such as a missing block. Click this 'i' for additional details in the info window. Alternatively, you can attach your zipped program to your post for others (or myself) to review.

Thanks, I overlooked the debug window. It shows: *** [date/time] Steam Oven *** PC --> [product_name] Blocks without connection to an output: Download PC --> [product_name] failed. I'm having trouble locating the block without an output connection. I'll attach the program for review. Thanks,
Found the solution myself—closed off the Q output blocks with open connectors.
The message block B009 is the one not connected to an output. Refer to the attached video for clarification.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced difficulty downloading a program to their [product_name] device, even though network connectivity was established and they could go online. The root cause was a misconfiguration in [product_name] software: some program blocks were not connected to outputs, blocking the download process. Users relied on debug and error messages within the software to pinpoint and resolve this issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect hassle-free program downloading and execution on their [product_name] hardware when connectivity is not an issue. They also anticipate that the software should clearly identify reasons for any download failures, including configuration errors.
